Bidder/ Seller Must not have been blacklisted by any Government Offices/ Societies/ Authorities (St ate Govt. or Government of India) / PSU / Govt. run autonomous body, Society in India for corrupt, fraudule nt or any other unethical business practices or any other reason. To that effect, the firm must submit addit ional terms and condition (ATC) in form of Notary Affidavit in Non-Judicial Stamp Paper (Rs.100/-) by menti oning the GeM BID number. 2. No conditional offer/quotation will be entertained. Quotations with variation in the terms and condit ions of the tender including major deviation from standards/ specifications/terms of supply will be rejected. The Purchaser reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids, wholly or partly, without assigning any reason. 3. Any addendum/corrigendum issued shall be part of the bid document and shall be communicated t o all the bidders via the GeM portal. It is responsibility of the bidder to check/verify the GeM portal for the l atest information related to the bid and the buyer shall not be liable for any lapse or negligence by the bid der. 4. The bidder shall have experience in supplying Desktop Computers or similar IT equipment to Gover nment Departments, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies or Educational Institutions during the last three years. Copi es of Purchase Orders/Work Orders along with proof of satisfactory execution shall be submitted. 5. Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF): Wherever Authorized Distributors/Reseller are submi tting bids, the Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF)/Certificate signed by authorized representative of th e OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) with details such as name, designation, address, еmail Id and Ph one Number shall be furnished along with the GeM bid number. The buyer will verify such certificate with t

he OEM. Any bid without valid OEM Authorization with Bid Id specifically shall be summarily rejected in tec hnical stage. 6. It is necessary for the OEM to have its own service centers within the Buyer Jurisdiction. The bid mu st include contact details of the service providers and documentary evidence confirming the existence of t hese service centers/ offices in the State of Maharashtra. Failure to provide this information will result in t he rejection of the bid. 7. The bidder must have sufficient manpower to provide after sales maintenance support. The bidder must have experience of supply, installation & maintenance of IT equipment at Districts, Sub Divisions & Bl ock level Government Offices preferably in Maharashtra. 8. The bidder shall ensure that the product/equipment offered must not contain any refurbished comp onent. In any event if it is found that any delivered item found to be refurbished will be rejected. 9. The bidder must submit complete financial records including ITRs, balance sheets, trading and P&L statements, annual turnover, GST returns, and professional tax records for the past three financial years e nding on 31.03.2026. 10. All documents submitted by bidder should be self-attested with official seal and signature. 11. Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid: 11.1 This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, d oes not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to: - 11.1.1 Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. 11.1.2 Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. 11.1.3 Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. 11.2 The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical da mage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are c aused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 12. Additional terms and conditions. 12.1 Genuine version of Windows 11 Professional (64 bit) should be preinstalled in the PCs. Any r equirement of activation after delivery must be through offline mode only. 12.2 Recovery media for OS and other applications has to provide in the form of CD/DVD. 12.3 The PCs should have CD/DVD drive. 12.4 Faulty Hard disks/RAM/ Internal memory of Desktop computers will not be returned in case of rep lacement of PC within warranty period. 12.5 The following Certificate shall be provided alongwith bid documents:- 12.5.1 Factory License Certificate. 12.5.2 ISO 9001. 12.5.3 BIS BEE Star. 12.6 The bidder must submit paper license at the time of delivery. Payment for the PCs will be rel eased after the verification of below details for each PC. 12.6.1 Serial Number. 12.6.2 HDD and SSD make, model and manufacturing year. 12.6.3 Windows Product Key, Installation and Confirmation ID. 12.6.4 MS Office Product key, Installation and Confirmation ID. 13. Warranty & Maintenance

13.1 Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 3 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the sc ope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in ca se of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending t he after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded al ong with the bid. 13.2 Comprehensive onsite warranty of 03 years by the bidder directly or through OEM with back -to-back spare parts support of the OEM of all the Hardware items for full term of Warranty period, shall have to be efficiently and promptly provided from the date of Installation of Equipment. The b idder shall submit Service escalation matrix with toll free number details. 13.3 If any Component/ Hardware gives continued trouble, for more than 03 times within 01 mon th during the warranty period or does not work at all as required, the successful bidder shall replac e the same, with new Component/ Hardware having the same or higher configuration without any a dditional cost. 14. The Purchaser reserves the right to cancel or withdraw the bidding process, either wholly or partly, at any stage prior to the issuance of the Purchase Order, without assigning any reason and without incurri ng any financial or legal liability whatsoever to the bidders. No claim for compensation or damages shall b e entertained on this account. The decision of the Purchaser shall be final and binding. . 2.
